name: G. Box
description: The benchmark. Boxes, couvettes and precious caskets plus display work, for perfume, cosmetics, fashion, advertising and champagne. Founded 1991 in Monza by Giovanni Ciscato; joint venture with Giovanardi Spa since 2011 to reach international volumes while keeping the artisan bench.

name: Faenza Couture Packaging
specs: MOQ 1–1,000; same-day proto; FSC; ISO 9001; ISO 14001; Impact Zero
description: Rigid bottom-and-lid boxes, cosmetic and luxury boxes. In-house design consultation through to manual assembly, and the only house here that publishes its minimum. Recyclable, biodegradable and compostable stocks.

name: Kartolab
description: Cartotecnica and legatoria under one roof: cofanetti, astucci, sample-carrier boxes, covered boxes, Bodoniana binding. Founded 2014 on fifty years of family trade. Has worked for Acqua di Parma, Cassina, Cappellini and Poliform.

name: L'Ottagono
description: Luxury cofanetti with magnetic closures, interior mirrors, engraved logos and bespoke finishes. Cosmetics, fashion, design, food and beverage, hospitality.

name: Montanelli 3
description: Cases for cosmetics, jewellery and perfumery, plus automotive and medical. Hot lamination and material coupling in house — the address to try when you want a covering nobody else is using.

name: Cartotecnica Sama
description: Custom and die-cut boxes with luxury finishing. Die-cutting from small formats up to 80/120, hot stamping, embossing and creasing, gluing and assembly. Luxury, cosmetics, perfume, footwear, jewellery, wine.

name: Arti Grafiche Villa
specs: est. 1960; gold/holo lam.; UV varnish; screen print
description: Since 1960. Custom boxes, gift boxes, cases and displays, with a full finishing bench: lamination in silver, gold and holographic, UV varnish, screen print, hot and blind embossing.

name: Arti Grafiche 3G
description: Fifty years of packaging, die-cut boxes and cases. Screen printing, hot foil and special effects for fashion, publishing and cosmetics clients.

name: Picchio Packaging
description: Founded 1959 making articles for philately and numismatics — small precise containers — and grown into custom packaging of every kind.

name: Pozzoli
specs: est. 1968; 160 staff; emboss; hot foil; soft-touch; FSC/PEFC
description: Industrial scale, artisan finishing options. Rigid and folding boxes for cosmetics and perfumery, plus vinyl packaging. In-house R&D with patents; 7,600 m² automated warehouse doing kitting and just-in-time.

name: ISEM
description: The European benchmark for luxury rigid boxes in perfumery, cosmetics and champagne — Coty, L'Oréal, Shiseido, LVMH. Founded in Vigevano in 1949; eleven plants across the group. Volumes far above a small house.

name: Stilema / Stilux
specs: est. 1983; made in Asia; showroom MI
description: Luxury secondary packaging since 1983 — rigid boxes, textile items, advent calendars, eyeglass holders. Manufacturing is in the Far East; Milan is office, commercial department and showroom, with sourcing and QC offices in China. Different proposition from everyone else here.

section: Fitted cases — wood, covered board, moulded
name: Confalonieri
specs: est. 1889; wood carcass; leather cover; velvet interior
description: Milanese since 1889 and still a family bench. Handmade wooden cases and boxes for watches, jewellery, eyewear and trophies, covered in leather or fabric with satin or velvet interiors. Also printed paper, ribbons and displays, so a coordinated set is possible from one supplier.

section: Fitted cases — wood, covered board, moulded
name: Ve.Lia Astucci
description: Founded 1956, and the deepest technical bench on this list. Over 600 proprietary moulds. Injection moulding, polystyrene thermoforming, tissue and foam die-cutting, custom wood cases with covering, flocked fabric pouches, metal and sample cases. Interiors in shaped foam, velvet or thermoformed insert. Takes contract moulding, fabric cutting and thermoforming work.

Embroidery in house. Solar-powered plant; handles runs into the millions. Confirm the address before quoting.

name: ATA

name: Eco Bags

name: Elvicart

name: Shopperland
description: Twenty years of personalised shoppers with logo, for perfumeries, jewellers, hotels and spas. Also tissue paper, ribbons and swing tags — a coordinated set from one desk.
